_doc: Tournaments shown on the Tournaments page (beta/tournaments_page.py, beta/tournaments.html); the home page
(beta/home_rankings.py, beta/landing.html) carried them as a table until 2026-11-21.
Each runs from its first game (`start`, a run tag; every game with a later tag
that matches `match` counts) in series of `series_size` finished games, read off
the ledger's results.jsonl at publish time. A game's best run counts once; a
launch that never reached a board (outcome unfinished) is not a game.
An optional `end` (a run tag) closes a definition: only games whose tag sorts before it count.
An optional `note` is shown in the table's Notes column on every series of its definition.
Operator /goal 2026-11-19 ~18:35Z: repeated 10-game series against Lv 8 Deity AI,
6P Continents; conditions Lv 8 6P Continents Online.
Operator 2026-11-19 ~21:20Z: "Turn the ongoing tournament into a 100 game tournament": Tournament 1 stays the
first 10-game series; from Tournament 2's first game (civvis-20261119T204058Z) the series are 100 games.
Operator ~21:30Z: "actually lets just do 30 games for now, rather than 100": series of 30.
Operator ~22:45Z: "we should randomly choose a civ. but then we should pursue our top strategy for winning, given the civ" and
"lets restart the tournament with this in mind. best of 30 games": Tournament 2 closes at civvis-20261119T223800Z (a series cut short by
its definition's `end` still gets an end date); Tournament 3 is a new 30-game series from there.
Operator 2026-11-20 ~01:40Z: "tournament 2 was scraped. (can add a notes col). both civs and strategies were being
chosen at random (random strat among the top ~5 or so I think). but what should be done is picking a civ at random
and then picking our best strategy for the civ. should be fixed in tournament 3. unsure if tournament 1 is affected
(probably is).": the `note` on each definition.
Operator 2026-11-20 ~05:50Z: "make the ongoing tournament a 100 game tourney please. continue the existing games series":
Tournament 3 stays the best-of-30 that ended at civvis-20261120T045254Z; Tournament 4 keeps its games from there as a 100-game series.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~02:35Z: "finish off the 50 game tournament please. make the video": the 100-game definition becomes 50-game series,
so Tournament 4 is its first 50 games (through civvis-20261120T150010Z) and Tournament 5 continues from the next.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~05:20Z: "have tournament 6 be: 10 games on lv 4, 10 games on lv 5, 10 games on lv 6, 10 games on lv 7, 10 games
on lv 8. 6p continents. 2 civvis agents and 4 deity ais ... start automatically once you finish the current tournament"; whole game
at that level, a game is a win when either CIVVIS agent wins. Those games are hotseat tables tagged `civvis-t6-<utc>`, so the
single-seat 50-game definition ends at "civvis-t" (every `civvis-2026...` tag sorts before it) and the table owns its own prefix.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~05:35Z: "Between Home and CIVVIS, we want to add a Tournaments view. This is my Simulator Experiments page
essentially. I have an idea I want to run. I schedule in a tournament for it. The AI models just keep working away at games.":
scheduling a tournament is adding its definition to this list. A definition none of whose games has finished is listed on the
Tournaments page as scheduled, in the order of this list, numbered on from the last tournament begun. One that is to wait its turn
owns a tag prefix (`civvis-t7-`), as Tournament 6 does, so it can be defined before the games ahead of it are played.
An optional `idea` says in a sentence what the tournament tests; the page shows it under the tournament's name.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~07:00Z: "on our new tournaments page we are building out. we can link to the youtube tournament result videos.":
`videos` names a tournament's result video on the CIVVIS YouTube channel, by the tournament's number as the page shows it (a
definition played as repeated series is several tournaments, so the link cannot sit on a definition). The page links it under the
tournament's name. The operator posts the videos; add a line here when one is up. Only a YouTube watch link is linked.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~14:50Z: "for tournament 6, lets cut back to 5 games at each level (5 on lv 4... 5 on lv 8)": 25 games.
Operator 2026-11-21 ~20:35Z: "for each tournament, we should have a short description. T1: Proof of concept, 10 game series.
T2: Abandoned. T3: 30 game series. T4: 50 game series T5: Repeat 50 game series but with 2/6 CIVVIS AI Agents (2nd half no
Diplo allowed). T6: Benchmarking across levels: 5 games at each level (no Diplo allowed). the descriptions can be on the title
line. please make title line bigger too.": `descriptions` gives a tournament's short description, by the tournament's number
as the page shows it, like `videos` and for the same reason (Tournaments 4 and 5 are one definition). The page writes it on the
tournament's title line, "Tournament 4: 50 game series". They are the operator's words; every tournament has one, so add a
line here when a tournament is scheduled or begins. A definition may carry its own `description` instead, which is used when
`descriptions` has no line for its number (a scheduled tournament's number can move if the queue is reordered).

descriptions.5: Repeat 50 game series but with 2/6 CIVVIS AI Agents (2nd half no Diplo allowed)
descriptions.6: Benchmarking across levels: 5 games at each level (no Diplo allowed)
